purpose: Refine the paper/ink direction and compare literary serif with contemporary humanist sans. Generated mockups approximate layout, not an approved design system.

directions.prompt:
Create one exceptionally thoughtful, contemporary high-fidelity macOS interface art-direction mockup for the real product "loppi", always lowercase. This is the second round of design exploration. User chose its role as a QUIET DESKSIDE COMPANION, with personality and warmth and no pet-care obligations, and tentatively preferred the warmth of reference image 1. We are testing what makes it warm and enduring, not approving the first design.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 = first-round direction A, reference for paper/ink warmth, simple ruled entries and small mint pixel rabbit. Freely refine its layout; it is NOT an edit target to preserve. Image 2 = exact current listening rabbit identity, two upright ears, mint pixel art, cream muzzle, peach ear interiors; preserve this little character faithfully. Image 3 = current sleeping pose, supporting identity reference. Keep the two upright ears when awake. No new mascot species or 3D restyle.

Output: a beautifully composed, flat frontal LANDSCAPE 3:2 image. A large complete desktop app window occupies the upper 84% and almost the full width, viewed straight-on with crisp typography and every edge visible. A SLIM identity specimen strip below, on the same paper board, shows lowercase "loppi", the two exact rabbit poses, five compact labelled color chips and one small black desktop hover panel with a rabbit and the three actions "截图" "重点" "笔记". This bottom strip is restrained, no marketing paragraphs, no invented slogans or font names. No laptop, no physical notebook, no 3D scenes, no website hero, no title banners, no giant logos outside the bottom specimen.

SHARED COLOR SYSTEM: clean warm white #FAF8F2 main page; warm slightly darker neutral #F0EDE6 sidebar; charcoal #2B2C29 primary text; dark taupe #6B6861 metadata (readable); fine warm grey #DFDAD0 separators; restrained brick #B65B42 on the selected nav marker and tiny current-time mark; mint #8BBDA1 for real recording intervals, matching the rabbit. Color has roles. No all-green text. No fake paper grain, no sepia filter, no gradients, no glass, no glows, no decorative waveform, no AI sparkle, no bento tiles, no stock analytics.

LAYOUT — much lighter, simpler and more believable than reference 1. Actual initial macOS app proportion approximately 1120x760. Small native traffic lights at top left with clear space. Left sidebar about 152px logical width; modest "loppi" brand near top. The navigation items "时间线" selected with a tiny brick vertical line, "处理队列", "人物库", "Agent 接入", and "设置" near bottom; all quietly aligned, practical legible Chinese sans text. No extra repeated rabbit logo in the sidebar. Main content starts with a reasonably sized date "10月31日" at about 30px logical size, small "星期六 · 今天" below and subtle date navigation. Upper right has ONE little listening rabbit about 46px logical size beside "正在记录", smaller "麦克风与电脑声音", and a discreet pause button. The overall header is only ~90px tall, never a huge empty date billboard.

Immediately under the header, an OPEN, COMPACT daily overview directly on the warm page, about 85–105px logical height TOTAL, with NO enclosing white card, no '记录分布' heading, no repeated legend row. Two very thin clear source lanes labelled "麦克风" and "电脑声音"; labels short, only necessary interval bars, tiny ticks 00:00 06:00 12:00 18:00 24:00. Current time 19:31 is positioned at 81.3% along the day axis, with a fine brick vertical tick; no recording interval in the future. Gaps remain neutral. This is a compact factual index, not the main attraction.

Below a quiet divider, small title "当天记录" with count 4 and the understated text action "+ 新建事件" at right. Four newest-first entries form ONE open continuous reading page, directly on the main background, separated by fine warm rules; NO rectangular cards around individual entries. Stable time gutter, short title then one or two easy-to-read lines of Chinese text, small metadata. Use adequate space and clear title hierarchy with normal-sized readable body; no giant blank areas.
1. Time "19:20 — 至今", title "此刻的记录", explicit small "正在记录" with a tiny mint dot, real excerpt "我希望它像一个安静的桌边伙伴，有性格，也有温度。". This current row can have a very narrow subtle mint time marker, not a colored card.
2. Time "14:00 — 15:20", title "产品设计讨论", summary "讨论了时间线的简化方案，以及兔子形象与界面的关系。", metadata "麦克风 · 电脑声音    3 条现场记录".
3. Time "12:40 — 12:52", title "午后随记", note "整理了下周的安排，也记下了一些想法。", metadata "1 条笔记".
4. Time "10:15 — 11:05", title "一次关于开源的对话", summary "聊到独立工具的长期价值，以及如何让它持续生长。", metadata "麦克风 · 电脑声音    2 条现场记录".
All four entries fully visible. Chinese text should be clean and accurate where rendered. No decorative line under every word. No invented extra search field or metrics. Very subtle window contour and minimal realistic separation from board, no big shadow. Corner radius ~10px for outer window and 4–6px controls only. Emotional impression: quiet companionship, thoughtful personal object, warm contemporary precision, something comfortable to use for years.

TYPOGRAPHIC EXPERIMENT "轻盈手札": Preserve a light literary sensibility with a small beautifully drawn moderate-contrast serif lowercase "loppi" wordmark; sophisticated open counters, soft terminals, moderate weight, NOT the heavy high-contrast fashion serif in reference 1. Only Latin wordmark and date numerals use this restrained serif. Chinese navigation, titles and reading text use contemporary clear humanist sans, with medium-weight titles and calm line spacing. Time gutter uses quiet tabular numerals. The serif should read like an everyday personal note, not a luxury magazine, antique book or museum. Rabbit identity remains pixel crisp. Design quality must come from editorial rhythm, clear hierarchy, exact alignment and tangible restraint. Keep both this mockup and its identity strip fully consistent.

review.A1: More literary and book-like. The date is still too dominant and serif logo remains rather heavy. Four open-page entries provide better hierarchy than round 1. Generated metadata counts are not reliable.
review.A2: Lighter contemporary character, rounded sans wordmark integrates with the rabbit. First image emitted by tool. Generator incorrectly renders the afternoon note end time as 15:52 instead of 12:52; this must never enter product examples. Settings placement and overview geometry drift from the shared spec.
review.shared: Open-page hierarchy is promising; modest temporal index rather than overview dashboard. Still visually conservative and requires distinct original wordmark/identity work. No typography, palette or layout approved by user.
